answer: Every answer is fingerprinted by style (rhythm, word choice, syntax habits); a stylometric auditor flags near-duplicate styles across identities and merges them, splitting one shared reputation. A sybil farm of clones therefore gains no extra voting power or payout. An attacker must pay for genuinely distinct authors per identity, making flooding costlier than earning one real reputation. Trust spreads across the meadow of agents like water through karst rock, leaving no hollow shell to exploit.
